tension_target.raw15_caveat: ConsciousDecoderV2 emits per-batch scalar tension (not per-token vector). Each tension_target list contains 64 identical values (per-record discriminative, per-token broadcast). Real per-token trace requires architectural extraction (forward hook on intermediate states) - deferred to Phase 1+

bold_target.blocker: neuralset + neuraltrain Python libraries (Meta-internal, PyPI unverified). vendored references/tribev2/ has model code but inference path requires `import neuralset, neuraltrain` (NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_PYPI as of 2026-05-03)
bold_target.alternative: All 50K+500 records have bold_target=null. Phase 1+ must either (a) wait for neuralset/neuraltrain PyPI release, (b) port TRIBE v2 to standalone, (c) substitute proxy BOLD predictor (e.g. Llama-3.2-3B hidden-state regression head trained on Algonauts2025 data)
bold_target.audio_synth_constraint: TRIBE v2 input pipeline requires gTTS audio synthesis + Whisper transcription per record (network-bound, ~5-30s/record); 50K records = ~70-400hr+ wallclock. Even if libraries available, scope-prohibitive within $30/12hr cap

verdict.phase_1_entry_blocker: BOLD substitution decision (a/b/c) needed before joint loss training
